script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - DAY

The hum of dribbling basketballs fills the room. Sweat drips from the brows of energetic TEENAGERS as they practice their shots.

COACH JONES (40s, stern but fair) watches from the sideline. He notices two new faces: JAMES (15, lanky, anxious) and CHRIS (15, stocky, confident).

JAMES
(whispers to CHRIS)
I've never played before.

CHRIS
(smiling)
Don't worry, James. We'll learn together.

COACH JONES
(approaching)
You two. Come here.

They join COACH JONES near the sidelines.

COACH JONES
(sternly)
You're late. And I don't see any uniforms.

JAMES
(nervous)
We didn't have uniforms, sir. We just moved here.

CHRIS
(supportive)
We'll get them soon, Coach.

COACH JONES
(sighs)
Fine. But you both have a lot to prove.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL CAFETERIA - LATER

James and Chris sit together at a table. They're surrounded by the school's star athletes, who are less than welcoming.

STAR ATHLETE 1 (16, popular)
(laughs)
What are you guys even doing here?

CHRIS
(smiling)
We're trying out for the basketball team.

STAR ATHLETE 2 (17, arrogant)
(scoffs)
Good luck with that.

James looks down, discouraged, but Chris places a reassuring hand on his shoulder.

CHRIS
Don't worry, James. We'll make it.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - PRACTICE

James and Chris practice together, slowly improving their skills. The team notices their progress, and they begin to accept the newcomers.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - LATER

The team gathers around COACH JONES.

COACH JONES
(looking at the roster)
It's time to announce the final roster for the basketball team.

As he reads the names, James and Chris hold their breath.

COACH JONES
(reading)
James and Chris... you're in.

The team cheers, and James and Chris share a relieved and excited smile.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - GAME DAY

The team huddles together before their first game. James looks nervous, but Chris puts a reassuring hand on his shoulder.

CHRIS
(encouraging)
We got this, James.

The game begins, and though they stumble at first, James and Chris work together, improving with each play.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - POSTGAME

The team gathers around their victorious coaches, but James and Chris are nowhere to be found.

COACH JONES
(looking around)
Where are James and Chris?

The team looks around, confused.

Suddenly, the doors to the gym burst open, and James and Chris enter, carrying a new uniform set for each team member.

CHRIS
(grinning)
We got you guys new uniforms.

The team cheers, and James and Chris join in, beaming with pride.

FADE OUT.

THE END
